decks.notes: This deck focuses on quick and aggressive gameplay with a combination of Azorius cards. It emphasizes utilizing cards that provide protection and evasion, allowing your creatures to deal damage efficiently while ensuring they stay safe. By combining cards that boost creatures' power and toughness, such as Homestead Courage and Luminarch Aspirant, with evasion and protection spells like Jwari Disruption and Sejiri Shelter, you can overwhelm your opponent and secure victory. The deck also features some key flying creatures like Stormchaser Drake to deliver swift damage to your opponent.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counter spells and removal, while using powerful dragons and enchantments to finish off the opponent. Goldspan Dragon and Hinata, Dawn-Crowned provide strong creatures to pressure the opponent, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Magma Opus offer flexibility and card advantage. Jwari Disruption and Expressive Iteration help with card selection and disruption. The deck aims to control the board and outvalue the opponent, eventually winning through overwhelming threats and powerful spells.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through counter spells and removal, while also generating value through card advantage with cards like Expressive Iteration and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. It aims to control the board with powerful threats like Goldspan Dragon and Bloodtithe Harvester, while also having access to efficient removal spells like Infernal Grasp. The mana base provides flexibility in casting spells efficiently and the inclusion of Make Disappear allows for additional removal options. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through resource management and control tactics.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of low-cost, aggressive white creatures. By steadily building up a board presence with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Luminarch Aspirant, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain control of the battlefield. The addition of key removal spells like Valorous Stance and Elite Spellbinder help to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect your own creatures. The deck's strategy is to rapidly build a strong army of creatures and maintain pressure throughout the game.

This deck focuses on countering and controlling the opponent's spells while utilizing powerful creatures like Goldspan Dragon and Galazeth Prismari to quickly close out the game. The deck also includes removal spells like Dragon's Fire and Shatterskull Smashing to deal with threats on the board. Additionally, it includes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Voltage Surge to generate card advantage and maintain tempo in the game. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through counterplay and efficient creature threats.

The main goal of this Jeskai Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy by countering their spells, removing their threats, and generating card advantage. By utilizing cards like Lier, Disciple of the Drowned, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, and Expressive Iteration, the deck aims to control the board and out-value the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes powerful threats like Goldspan Dragon to close out the game quickly once control has been established. The inclusion of various counterspells, removal spells, and card draw options allows the deck to adapt to different matchups and dominate the late game.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing powerful control spells like Negate and Valorous Stance, along with disruptive cards like Jwari Disruption and Make Disappear. The key strategy is to delay opponents with counters and removal while ramping up with Goldspan Dragon and Hinata, Dawn-Crowned to close out the game with big threats like Magma Opus. The mana base is designed to provide flexibility and consistency, allowing for a smooth progression towards victory through a combination of disruption, card advantage, and powerful finishers.

The deck focuses on controlling the board and the opponent's actions through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. It aims to stall the game until it can establish a strong board presence with powerful creatures like Goldspan Dragon and Titan of Industry. The deck also utilizes land synergies and versatile spells like Expressive Iteration to efficiently draw cards and ramp up mana. The win condition can be achieved through dealing damage with creatures or using Koma, Cosmos Serpent's ability to create an unbeatable board state.

The deck focuses on aggressively building a board presence with a mix of powerful creatures and disruptive spells to control the game. By utilizing a combination of aggressive threats like Luminarch Aspirant and Spectral Adversary, along with removal spells like Infernal Grasp and Make Disappear, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent while disrupting their strategy. The inclusion of cards like Exotic Pets and Raffine, Scheming Seer allows for card advantage and flexibility in adapting to different situations. Finally, the mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive game plan while providing the necessary colors for its spells.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with disruptive spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. By using cards like The Wandering Emperor, Tainted Adversary, and Luminarch Aspirant, it aims to quickly build up a threatening board presence. Meanwhile, cards like Vanishing Verse and Infernal Grasp are used to remove key opposing threats. The deck also includes some card draw and utility spells like Make Disappear and Wedding Announcement to support its game plan. The deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful creatures. The main concept of this deck is to control the game by countering opponents' spells, removing threats, and disrupting their strategy.
